blocks.html:
The Rectorate is one of USI’s central bodies together with the University Council and the Academic Senate. The Rectorate, led by the Rector, ensures the overall smooth functioning of the University and elaborates planning and development acts.

Members and functions

The Rectorate comprises of the Rector, the Secretary General, the Director of Operations, and the Pro-Rectors. Its functions are stated in the Statute of the Università della Svizzera italiana (in Italian).

Current members

blocks.name: Claudio L. A. Bassetti
blocks.html:
Claudio L.A. Bassetti was born in Bellinzona in 1958. He earned his medical degree from the University of Basel in 1984, trained in neurology in Bern and Lausanne, and completed research fellowships in experimental neurophysiology (Basel) and sleep medicine (Ann Arbor, United States). In 2000, he was appointed Professor of Neurology at the University of Zurich. Formerly Head of Neurology at the Ospedale Regionale di Lugano (EOC), he founded and directed the Neurocentro della Svizzera italiana in 2009. In 2012, he relocated to Bern, where he was appointed full professor at the University of Bern and Director of the Department of Neurology at the Inselspital, guiding the institution to become an international centre of reference. In his dual role as Dean and Director of the DLF at the Inselspital, Claudio Bassetti has worked tirelessly to strengthen collaboration between the University and the Hospital, promoting excellence in patient care, teaching, and research. Throughout his career, he has worked as a general neurologist with a keen interest in teaching clinical skills, while focusing his expertise on stroke and sleep. His research has spanned both human and animal models. He has authored over 660 scientific publications (H-index 115) and 10 books. He has served as President of the European Academy of Neurology, the European Sleep Research Society, and the Swiss Neurological Society, and was the founder of the Swiss Federation of Clinical Neuro-Societies. In 2018, he was elected a member of the Swiss Academy of Medical Sciences. He is a member of the Board of Directors of the Ente Ospedaliero Cantonale (EOC) and of the Foundation Board of the Institute for Research in Biomedicine (IRB). He is married and has three children. He speaks six languages and enjoys music, history, literature, and sport. He has held the position of Rector since 1 September 2026.

blocks.name: Gabriele Balbi
blocks.role: Pro-Rector for Education and Students' Experience
blocks.html:
Gabriele Balbi is Full Professor in Media Studies at the Institute of Media and Journalism (IMeG), Faculty of Communication, Culture and Society, USI Università della Svizzera italiana (Switzerland). At this institution, he is Pro-Rector for Education and Students' Experience, program director of the Bachelor in Communication, director of the China Media Observatory, and vice director of the Institute of Media and Journalism. Furthermore, he is Vice-Chair of ICA Communication History Division. He received a BA and MA in Communication Sciences at the University of Turin (Italy) in 2002 and 2004 and a PhD in Communication Sciences and Social History of Communication at USI in 2008. He has been lecturer and visiting professor at several universities: Harvard, Maastricht, Columbia, Westminster, Oxford, Northumbria, Perugia, Augsburg, and Concordia. His main research area is media history.

blocks.name: Antonio Carzaniga
blocks.role: Pro-Rector for Innovation and Corporate Relations
blocks.html:
Antonio Carzaniga is Full Professor and founding member (since 2004) of the Faculty of Informatics at Università della Svizzera italiana. He earned his degree in Electronic Engineering and his PhD in Computer Science from Politecnico di Milano in 1994 and 1999, respectively. From 2001 to 2007, he was also Assistant Research Professor in the Department of Computer Science at the University of Colorado at Boulder. His primary research interests are in the areas of distributed systems, software engineering, and communication networks. Antonio Carzaniga has served his faculty and USI in various roles. Among these, he was Dean of the Faculty of Informatics from 2017 to 2021, was a member of the Research Commission, and is a member of the Scientific Committee of the USI Startup Centre.

Personal page and contact

blocks.name: Fabio Crestani
blocks.html:
Fabio Crestani has been a full professor at USI Faculty of Informatics since January 2007. Before coming to Lugano, he was (full) Professor at the University of Strathclyde in Glasgow (UK) since 2000. During that time he was a Visiting Professor at IMAG (France), and spent a year sabbatical at UC Berkeley (USA) and Xerox PARC (USA). In 1997-1999 he was a Postdoctoral Research Fellow at the University of Glasgow (UK), at the International Computer Science Institute in Berkeley (USA), and at the Rutherford Appleton Laboratory (UK). Earlier, in 1992-97 he was Assistant Professor at the Department of Information Engineering of the University of Padova (Italy). While at USI, Fabio Crestani held a Catedra de Excellencia at the Universidad Carlos III de Madrid (Spain), an Isambard Kingdom Brunell Fellowship at the University of Portsmouth (UK) and spent sabbaticals at Yahoo! (USA) and the National Intitute of Informatics in Tokyo (Japan). Fabio Crestani holds a degree in Statistics from the University of Padova (Italy) and an MSc and PhD in Computing Science from the University of Glasgow (UK). His main research areas are Information Retrieval, Text Mining and Digital Libraries. He has authored one book, co-edited 14 and published over 300 articles. He was editor-in-chief of Information Processing and Management (Elsevier) from 2008 to 2015 and is still a member of the editorial board of a number of journals.

blocks.name: Sonja Hildebrand
blocks.role: Pro-Rector for Sustainable Transformation and Equal Opportunities
blocks.html:
Sonja Hildebrand is Full Professor for the History of modern and contemporary architecture at USI Academy of Architecture and member of the Board of the Institute of the History and Theory of Art and Architecture (ISA). She obtained her PhD in Art History at TU München in 1997 where she habilitated in 2008. Before joining USI in 2011 she held research and teaching positions at TU München, Universität Bamberg, Universität Zürich and ETH Zürich. She was Vice Dean for Research at the Academy of Architecture from 2017 to 2020 and served her Faculty and USI in various functions, amongst others as a co-President of the Accademy Doctoral Board, member of the Accademy Teaching Commission and USI Research Commission. Her research focuses on the history of architectural culture and theory of the 19th and 20th centuries. She was responsible for various research projects at TU München, ETH Zürich and USI funded by the SNSF and other Swiss and German research agencies. Currently she leads an SNSF project on Gottfried Semper’s main theoretical work „Der Stil“ (with Philip Ursprung, ETH Zürich). She published widely on the history of modern architecture and urbanism, architectural theory and education. Her publications include two monographs and ten edited volumes.

Personal page and contact

blocks.name: Raphaël Parchet
blocks.html:
Raphaël Parchet is a Full Professor of Economics at the Institute of Economics (IdEP) and the Institute for Economic Research (IRE) of the Faculty of Economics. He joined USI in 2013 as an Assistant Professor after a year of postdoctoral research at the University of Basel and the University of Lausanne. He obtained his PhD in Economics from the University of Lausanne in 2012, a Master of Science in Economics in 2007 and a Master of Science in Political Science in 2003, all from the same institution. His research interests focus primarily on taxation, tax competition, and the interplay between economic policies and political institutions. Since 2023, he has served as the Director of the Bachelor's in Economics.

Personal page and contact

blocks.name: Giovanni Zavaritt
blocks.html:
Giovanni Zavaritt (1979) holds a PhD in Political Communication and an Executive Master of Science in Communications Management. From 2014 to 2019 he was Head of Communication at USI. Since 2015 he has been member of the Board of the Science et Cité foundation. Giovanni Zavaritt is Secretary General of USI from September 2019.

Personal page and contact

blocks.name: Alan Valnegri
blocks.html:
Alan Valnegri (1978) graduated in 2002 with a degree in Management Information Systems from HEC Lausanne, following his studies at the Cantonal Business School in Bellinzona. His academic profile is further bolstered by several prestigious international certifications and recent specialisations in innovation, entrepreneurship, and leadership. A Swiss citizen, he is married and the father of two daughters. He has been serving as Director of Operations at USI since 1 September 2026.
